sources.label: Document
sources.name: PRD: EU Launch on Frankfurt Hosting Partner
sources.excerpt: The EU launch proceeds on the Frankfurt hosting partner as primary host for EU customer data. The launch depends on the data-residency assumption, which is supported by the partner's EU compliance certification and, independently, its SOC 2 Type II attestation.
